id: Passage multiplication: Pole input of a completed slope
note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved: weak_approx_q, pole_input_valuations and pole_input_small state the choice of q, the valuations of R/Theta^2 at S_b, at the selected primes and elsewhere, the square denominator and the positivity limit, with no named hypothesis. The unit claim for a and the trace residue count are steps of pole_input_valuations.

theorem weak_approx_q (S S' : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) (hS' : ∀ p ∈ S', p.Prime)
    (e : ℕ → ℕ) (x₀ δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (X : Finset ℝ) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, q ≠ 0 ∧ (q : ℝ) ∉ X ∧ |(q : ℝ) - x₀| < δ ∧
      (∀ p ∈ S, (e p : ℤ) ≤ padicValRat p q) ∧ ∀ p ∈ S', 0 ≤ padicValRat p q := by
